evidence.title: HAWKEYE: Seeing One Layer Deeper -- A Cohesion-Aware Structural Channel for Temporal Link Prediction

summary: A new study presents HAWKEYE, a structural channel model that enhances temporal link prediction by incorporating cohesion-aware mechanisms. The approach aims to improve accuracy in dynamic network analysis.
title: Researchers Introduce HAWKEYE: A New Cohesion-Aware Model for Temporal Link Prediction
